Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 153. Category: stance. Stances.

Prerequisites: Dexterity 13+
The trusty Turtle School, focusing on overwhelming
foes with swift flowing martial arts.
+1 Static Bonus for unarmed strikes and melee
techniques.
When you use your Action to make an unarmed
strike you may make an additional strike as part of
that action.
